result.quote: He was unfaithful to the LORD his God, for he entered the temple of the LORD to burn incense on the altar of incense.
result.reason: Verse 26:16 directly and uniquely identifies Uzziah’s trespass as entering the temple to burn incense on the altar of incense. His arrogance is also mentioned, but it is presented as what led to his destruction, not as the specific act asked for. The edit preserves the intended fact and answer scope.
